_comment: Walking Ballista (2026-10-27). The 4-mana loop: Heliod + Soul Warden out, 4 Plains, Ballista in hand. Control: lhc_ballista_x1_warden_bump_short_control (3 Plains). BINDING: active life 41 = Soul Warden's 1 + 20 lifelinked pings; opponent -1 = the 20 pings plus the Warden's post-kill swing (the executor still plays combat after a main-phase kill).
